checks.explanation: The specific '50% of white-collar jobs' claim being referenced (from Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei, made in 2025 with a 5-year horizon) has not yet had its full timeframe elapse. Early 2026 data is mixed but leans toward supporting Cuban's skepticism so far: modeled AI-attributable job losses are estimated at roughly 200,000-300,000, far short of a 50% white-collar wipeout, and many CEOs still expect to grow entry-level and senior hiring. At the same time, some research warns a 'Great Recession for white-collar workers' remains plausible, and youth employment in AI-exposed roles has already fallen meaningfully. Too early to score right or wrong.

This prediction is explicitly conditioned on events that haven't happened yet: it points to political normalcy returning after the 2026 midterms and the 2028 presidential election, neither of which has occurred as of this review (August 2026, with midterms still months away).
